reviews.label: Trina D
reviews.text: “I had breast reduction surgery in May. Dr. Lynm and the staff have been awesome. The scars are minimal and things are going great. I’m super pleased with the results. I would recommend Dr. Lynm to everyone. ”

reviews.label: Patient
reviews.text: “I interviewed Dr Lynam out of three Surgeons he was by far the best. I was a unique case and he went beyond the call of duty to make sure I was happy with my results. I can’t thank him and his staff enough… I highly recommend Dr Lynam. ”

reviews.label: Breast Reduction Patient
reviews.text: “Started out with breasts that were large for my framd but not overly so. Sailed through 20s and 30s with 34 C cups. My son died when I was 40 and that started me on a spiral of binge eating and shopping. I am now 55 and I have 38 G cup breasts that hang to my waist. Photos later. Had my first appointment on February 27th with PS. All documentation in. Insurance company has not received the info yet. Should I hound the doctors office to get the info to Healthkeepers? Does anyone else have Anthem Healthkeepers and did it take long to get approval. Also, I am so thankful for this group of women on this website. I check in here 10 times a day for all the support here.”

reviews.label: Breast Augmentation Patient
reviews.text: “After many consults and lots of research, I chose Dr. Lynam because he is simply the best surgeon for breast augmentation in my area. ”

reviews.label: Breast Reduction Patient
reviews.text: “Dr. Lynam is an artist when it comes to shaping breasts. His office was fantastic about helping me get insurance approval for my breast reduction surgery, and while I am less than a week post-op, I have a lot of faith that once my new “girls” are healed they will look great. I’m already pleased with the literal “weight off of my chest”, even though I’m in the early stages of healing.”

reviews.label: Breast Patient
reviews.text: “I actually had already decided on another area plastic surgeon, one of my coworkers recommended dr lynam and went in for a last minute consultation, from the minute we met I knew he would be my ps, he was professional, nice, funny and most importantly I felt comfortably with him. Everyone in his office was super nice. Stony point surgery center is a beautiful facility as well and all the nurses and staff there were awesome on day of surgery. Going in I had very realistic expectations and for just being one day post op, I couldn’t be happier. Dr lynam truly is one of a kind, I’m very pleased with my,results and look forward kt healing been more!”

reviews.label: Breast Augmentation Patient
reviews.text: “I was very unhappy with my body after losing weight. I went to Dr. Lynam for a consult and knew right then he would be the PS doing my surgeries. I am very very pleased with the results of both surgeries and plan to have Dr. Lynam perform other surgeries in the near future. I love what I see when I look in the mirror.”

reviews.label: Breast Lift & Implants Patient
reviews.text: “I met with Dr. Lynam for a consutation. He suggested that I only get a lift which I appreciated knowing that would cost much less. I did decide I would also like implants. When I went back for my pre-op appointment he took extra time to look at pictures I brought in. I have heard great things about him. I have my surgery Friday. I am super nervous.”

testimonials.label: Denise
testimonials.text: “I just wanted to say thank you for ‘being there’ for a patient in need today. You all were so responsive and accommodating when I called and shared a friend’s encounter with what seemed a lack of empathy. As a nurse, it is always so refreshing when other medical professionals don’t lose sight of the fact that at any moment it could be ourselves or a loved one who needs a helping hand. What a terrible day for my friend turned out to be a great one. I really appreciate it.”

testimonials.label: Jane
testimonials.text: “Dr. Lynam, thank you so much for doing such a “wonderful job” with my surgery. I really appreciate it. I was so worried and everything turned out just like I wanted it to. It is so great not to have my big left breast anymore.”
